senses.gloss: ch. sameto cut. Y. Orl. III, 63ᵃ top גָּזֵים וכ׳, v. גְּזִיזָה.

units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 16:30">Targ. Prov. XVI, 30</cite> (h. text <cite ref="S02142"><he>קרץ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Shevuot 46a:15">Shebu. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>עביד איניש דגזים וכ׳</he> a man frequently threatens mischief and does not do it.
<cite ref="Shevuot 46a:15">Ib.</cite> <he>הכי נמי ג׳ וכ׳</he> (not <he>דג׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) in this case, too, he may have threatened and not done it.
